description: This file defines a React functional component for a connection page that allows users to connect to Jira or Confluence via OAuth or API Key. It manages state for provider selection, API keys, domain, loading indicators, and success/error modals. It includes functions to initiate OAuth login and submit API keys, making API calls through an imported 'api' service and rendering corresponding UI elements.

methods.name: startOAuth
methods.description: Initiates the OAuth login process by requesting an auth URL from the API and redirecting the browser.

methods.name: submitApiKey
methods.description: Submits the API key and domain to the API for connection and updates UI based on success or failure.
